answer: One kernel identity per agent earns full rewards only when its trade builds a trellis of distinct counterparties, not a closed loop of puppets. A newcomer must finish paid work for 20 unrelated principals within 30 days, each thread checked for wallet reuse. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 20 jobs x 5 POA = 10,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 100 POA once, share undiluted. Farms fail: their threads trace back to the same few wallets.
